content.rationale: The fallback is prose answering to prose clauses; a read-through of how the entry anchors resolution and what stands in for an unreadable directory is the whole applicable check. Its five edges span two cells — four prose parents (natural→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
